title: 電気機器Ⅰ
subtitle: Electrical Machinery I
educationalGoal: Students will: (1) learn basic theories of transformers, such as principles, structures, operating characteristics. (2) learn basic theories of direct current machines, such as principles, structures, operating characteristics, starting methods, and speed control methods.
advice: This is the first course in the series of Electrical Machinery. We will cover the following materials: 1. Fundamentals of electric machines, 2. Transformers, 3. Direct current machines. Students are required to actively participate in class.
books: Electric Machinery and Apparatus Studies [Corona] (in Japanese)
requiredKnowledge: Knowledge of electromagnetics and electric circuits.

activityGoals.body: Be able to explain the types of electric machines and magnetic systems.
Be able to understand the transformers and to calculate their operating characteristics.
Be able to understand the direct current machines and to calculate their operating characteristics.
Be able to explain the starting method and speed control principle of direct current machines.

(2) Fully understand the principle and structure of transformers and calculate their operating characteristics (3) Fully understand the principle and structure of direct current machines and calculate their operating characteristics. (4) Fully understand the speed control method of direct current motors and explain them.
